items.explanation: Use 了 after 住 to show the one-month stay is completed.
Use 一个月 for a duration. 一月 usually means the month of January, while 一个月 means “one month.”
Use 了 after 搬家 to show the moving action is completed.
古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代。
老是 and 常常 both express repeated actions, so 常常 is redundant here.
It would be more natural to say 担心 here because it directly expresses that the mother worries about her son.
Use 变得 because becoming similar is a change of state. 成为 is used for becoming an identity or role.
告诉 introduces quoted speech, so use no 了 for the speaking word.
Add 你的 to make clear that these people are not Mencius's friends.
